ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_002
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 我……从来没觉得乐队有什么开心的

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_004
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……黄瓜。
那边是番茄……这边是茄子……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_012
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 因为我发消息给你，你也不回复……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_014
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
……爽世很担心你。
说想去你家……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_027
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 我现在还能听见观众们的欢呼声

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_034
ui_voice_tap#2.text:
爽世现在组了乐队。
她也邀请了我……

ui_voice_tap#2.name: voice_037
ui_voice_tap#2.text: 演出那天，应该能见到爽世她们

heart_voice_caption#2.text: 我……从来没觉得乐队有什么开心的

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_004
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……黄瓜。
那边是番茄……这边是茄子……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_012
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 因为我发消息给你，你也不回复……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_014
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
……爽世很担心你。
说想去你家……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_027
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 我现在还能听见观众们的欢呼声

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_034
heart_voice_caption#2.text:
爽世现在组了乐队。
她也邀请了我……

heart_voice_caption#2.name: voice_037
heart_voice_caption#2.text: 演出那天，应该能见到爽世她们
